build_system: Vite 6. Config file: frontend/vite.config.js. The workspace root package (code-impact-analysis) is a local file dependency — do NOT touch it.
test_framework: None — no test runner configured. Verification is build-only.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` inside the frontend directory. Zero errors required. After build succeeds, optionally run `npm run preview` to visually inspect at localhost:4173.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. All paths use backslashes in shell but forward slashes inside JS files. The parent package.json at the workspace root references 'code-impact-analysis': 'file:..'; do not modify it. The frontend has no .env — environment vars like VITE_NVIDIA_MODEL are read with import.meta.env and default gracefully if undefined.
contribution_requirements: Preserve ALL existing state, API calls, context imports, and Socket.io wiring in WorkspaceHub.jsx and every other page. Never remove logic — only change visual output (styles, layout, which components are rendered). Zero build errors required before commit.
key_patterns: 1. WorkspaceHub.jsx is the ~1800-line mega-component that all pages (Dashboard, Agents, CodeReview, etc.) delegate to via `activeTab` prop. Do NOT refactor its internal logic. 2. All components use inline styles — no CSS modules or Tailwind. 3. The `useAnalysis()` hook provides workflow, analysisData, reviewData, repositories, selectedRepo, etc. 4. The `useAuth()` hook provides user, logout, isAuthenticated. 5. Lucide-react (v1.28) is the only icon library. No three.js/R3F. 6. `mammoth` for .docx parsing is a dependency and must remain. 7. The AnimatedBackground component must be removed from App.jsx (but the file can remain untouched or be deleted — App.jsx must not import it). 8. Navbar.jsx is currently 72px tall, used in WorkspaceHub; it must be replaced by the new Topbar (48px). Sidebar.jsx must be replaced with icon-only 56px version.
directory_structure: frontend/src/pages/ — one file per route, all delegate to WorkspaceHub. frontend/src/components/ — shared UI components. frontend/src/context/ — AnalysisContext (workflow, analysisData, reviewData, repos) and AuthContext (user, isAuthenticated). frontend/src/services/ — api.js (fetch wrappers) and aiService.js (client-side AI fallback). frontend/src/routes/ — AppRoutes.jsx with auth guards.
